code_blocks.content:
Objection Q&A Builder

Turn product facts, buyer doubts, and proof into launch-ready Q&A cards, proof snippets, and a compact brief you can copy from your phone.

Product inputs

Use concrete specs, features, inclusions, limits, materials, dimensions, warranty, shipping, and care notes.

Best proof: numbers, tests, materials, warranty, reviews, comparison points, certifications, photos, before/after, and return policy.

Proof-strength meter

0

Add facts, doubts, and proof to score the launch support.
